environment.hardware: MacBook Pro Mac15,3, Apple M3, 8 CPU cores, 8 GiB reported device memory

configurationEvidence.source: Project Owner confirmation in the controlled Chrome session
configurationEvidence.method: Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Capture settings, CPU 4x slowdown
configurationEvidence.targetContinuity: The same inspected Chrome tab was retained for the constrained gesture and then navigated to the constrained cold-import/reload benchmark.

limitations: The browser evidence API does not expose the active DevTools CPU multiplier; the constrained setting is supported by the Project Owner confirmation and preserved target continuity.
DevTools CPU throttling is relative to the host and is not a claim about a specific mobile CPU architecture.

The constrained cold importer runs in a dedicated Worker. Its observed timings are retained as measured and are not represented as proof that DevTools applies an identical multiplier to every Worker execution context.
Main-thread heap signals exclude Worker, Canvas, and GPU allocations.
